headline: Executive order creates a federal COVID-19 Pandemic Testing Board and directs steps to build up the public health workforce.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order sets up a federal board to coordinate COVID-19 testing. It also calls for efforts to build and keep a public health workforce able to respond to COVID-19 and future biological threats. No summary was provided, so the specific duties and programs are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies involved in public health
who_it_affects.how: They would take part in or support a new board focused on COVID-19 testing.
The order aims to support a stable workforce for responding to COVID-19 and other biological threats.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed January 21, 2021; executive orders generally take effect when signed.
